function.name: forecast_run
function.description: 90-day cash forecast with 10,000 Monte Carlo scenarios. Returns the headline (probability of negative cash and crunch date), P10/P50/P90 per day, and which customer or factor drives the risk. Use it whenever a document or event may change future cash, and for what-if questions. Read-only (tier L0). Quote its numbers verbatim; never recompute them.

function.name: optimize_plan
function.description: Cheapest financing mix (MILP) that keeps cash above the buffer in `confidence` of the scenarios, compared with the default bank loan, with why each product is in or out. Returns `approval_request`: send it unchanged to POST /approvals so the owner approves exactly this plan (financing is always tier L3: OTP). Takes 3-10 s.

function.name: credit_passport
function.description: Explainable financial-health score (0-100, grade A-E) the SME can share with a lender. Only set consent=true if the owner explicitly agreed to share it; that adds a SHA-256 digest for the audit log. Read-only (L0) without consent; sharing is L2.

function.name: business_analysis
function.description: Business financial analysis for the owner: 90-day cash budget by month, where the money goes (outflows by category), customer concentration, receivables (DSO, aging), currency exposure with a 10% peso shock, payroll coverage with its Monte Carlo risk, and plain findings in EN / ES / 中文 (`insights`). Read-only (L0). Quote its numbers and texts verbatim.
